answer: Locks are published in wharf, expire in grove, and quill lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 17 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An attacker running 182 aliases as a result needs 195 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4789 identities would post 4043 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
